verdicts.reason: A is broken. '20% off' wraps onto two lines and '20%' runs into the body copy. The body copy is a narrow, ragged column of one or two words per line, placed above and beside the headline, so the reading order is jumbled. 'WEEKEND ONLY' wraps, the bottle is jammed against the top edge, and the peach circle is cut down to a stub. B keeps the original's left text column (eyebrow, headline, body, CTA) and the bottle on the circle, all clearly structured. Its only flaws are minor: the bottle sits slightly low and off-centre on the circle, and the space below the CTA is a little uneven.
